details.description: Qwen3.7-Plus (listed on Fireworks AI under the path qwen3p7-plus) is a closed, proprietary flagship model in Alibaba's Qwen 'Plus' tier. Alibaba Cloud's Model Studio lists it in both its text-generation and image-and-video-understanding model catalogs, indicating it accepts text and image or video input for tasks such as extracting descriptions or structured data from visual content. Fireworks AI's own listing describes it as Alibaba's latest flagship closed model, available exclusively through Fireworks outside of Alibaba's own infrastructure, and shows function-calling (tool use) support. Alibaba does not publish parameter counts, architecture details or benchmark scores for this closed model on the pages available.
advantages: Accepts image and video input for understanding tasks such as extracting text descriptions or structured data from visual content, per Alibaba Cloud Model Studio's model catalog.
Supports function calling (tool use), per its Fireworks AI hosted listing.
disadvantages: Closed, proprietary model: Alibaba does not publish parameter counts, architecture details (dense or Mixture-of-Experts) or independently verifiable benchmark scores for it on the pages available.
Described by Fireworks AI as available exclusively through Fireworks outside of Alibaba's own infrastructure, limiting independent verification of its capabilities beyond the two listings found.
use_cases: General text generation and chat, per its listing in Alibaba Cloud Model Studio's text-generation catalog
Extracting text descriptions or structured data from images and video, per Alibaba Cloud Model Studio's image-and-video-understanding catalog
Tool-calling and function-calling workflows, per its Fireworks AI listing

notes: Qwen3.7-Plus is a closed, proprietary Alibaba model; its own model-detail page (the website_url above) is a JavaScript console app that returned no readable content via automated fetch, so this entry relies on Alibaba Cloud Model Studio's model-catalog listing page (which names and categorizes the model under 'qwen3.7-plus') and Fireworks AI's hosted model page (which supplies the description and capability flags). No parameter count, architecture, or benchmark scores were found on the pages that could be read. Catalog facts (262,144 max input tokens, 65,536 max output tokens, image_input+text_input+text_output modality) were not independently confirmed or contradicted by either page opened; Fireworks lists context length as 'N/A' rather than a specific number.
